transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: Good evening, I’m Mitra, an AI interviewer. Nice to meet you. How are you doing?

transcript_turns.speaker: candidate
transcript_turns.text: I am doing well, thank you. Happy to be here.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: Glad to hear it. What are you working on now?

transcript_turns.speaker: candidate
transcript_turns.text: I'll lead the payouts platform at a fintech company, mostly reliability and routing work.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: Thanks. Let's begin. What was the key bet behind a product strategy you shaped?

transcript_turns.speaker: candidate
transcript_turns.text: Two years ago I said the strategy to move payouts to multi-acquirer routing, because single processor outages were costing us merchants. I made the case to finance with six months of failure data.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: What did you believe about the market that your team did not share?

transcript_turns.speaker: candidate
transcript_turns.text: We delayed the merchant dashboards for two quarters and put two engineers on reconciliation instead. It was a hard call, but failures were the bigger risk.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: Okay. What market belief did you hold that others on your team did not?

transcript_turns.speaker: candidate
transcript_turns.text: The hardest trade-off was between a big merchant's custom feature and fixing payout failures for everyone. I chose the failures, and explained it to the merchant with the numbers.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: Thanks for sticking with this. Let me wrap up and close our conversation.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: What’s one lesson you carry forward from that decision?

transcript_turns.speaker: candidate
transcript_turns.text: Our head of sales disagreed strongly. Five are weekly shares of the team 99 percent.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: Thank you for your time today. Goodbye.
